morphology.pattern_note: 作为完整借入的形容词记忆，不把 -onal 当作马来语能产后缀。派生 ketradisionalan 时添加 ke-...-an，词基拼写保持不变。

senses.zh_definition: 传统的；与代代传承的习俗、知识、技艺或生活方式有关，或具有、遵循这类传统的。
senses.en_definition: Relating to, characteristic of, or following customs, knowledge, or practices handed down across generations.
senses.ms_definition: Berkaitan dengan, bersifat, atau mengikut tradisi.
senses.nuances: 强调传承关系，可以形容食物、服饰、艺术、医学及生活方式；不自动表示落后、古老或未经改变。通常置于名词之后，如 makanan tradisional。[DBP：tradisional](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=tradisional)

dual_scenarios.context: 文化新闻 / 活动报告
dual_scenarios.ms: Program itu memperkenalkan permainan tradisional kepada generasi muda melalui bengkel dan demonstrasi.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该活动通过工作坊和示范，向年轻一代介绍传统游戏。
dual_scenarios.en: The programme introduces traditional games to younger generations through workshops and demonstrations.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku nak cari kuih tradisional kat pasar tu.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya hendak mencari kuih tradisional di pasar itu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我想去那个市集找些传统糕点。
dual_scenarios.en: I want to look for some traditional kuih at that market.

etymology.historical_story: Tradisional belongs to the international vocabulary of tradition, whose deeper Latin background concerns handing something over. That image suits customs passed between generations: recipes, dances, stories, and skills. The deeper history does not establish the immediate route by which Malay borrowed this adjective. In present-day Malay, tradisional functions as a complete word alongside the related noun tradisi. [Historical discussion of tradition](https://pup-assets.imgix.net/onix/images/9780691205151/9780691205151.pdf?fm=pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tra-di-sio-nal 与英语 traditional 配对：先记 tradisi＝传统，再把 tradisional 整词记为“传统的”。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 谈论各族传统时采用尊重、具体的描述。tradisional 本身中性，避免用轻蔑语气把它等同于落后或迷信。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 马来西亚不同族群和地区都有各自的传统；需要准确区分时，可说 makanan tradisional Melayu 或 tarian tradisional masyarakat Iban。perubatan tradisional 是类别名称，单凭 tradisional 不能判断疗效。
